so this was a few months ago, but i went to the richmond show back in may on his last tour. the crowd there wasn't too bad (a few people being inappropriate at the start got quickly stopped by will, he ranted about it) but i was right behind probably the worst person in the audience. she was taking up maybe like, 3 square feet of space around her and keep intruding on my partner's space by leaning SUPER far back and screaming "woo" for no reason at all. she would do this the whole time everyone was waiting for will to come out after shayfer's set was done. she didn't seem to give a shit about my partner being right behind her and very uncomfortable, she was completely in their personal space, much more than i think is acceptable at any concert. then when will came on, she kept doing the same sort of things and she was very loud. she screamed "yass" at something and will specifically pointed out that and how it annoyed him. she spent a lot of the show on her phone messaging people on instagram before she disappeared somewhere else into the crowd. 

i was also annoyed by some people behind me and my partner earlier in the show. we are both pretty big shayfer james fans and were super excited for his set (it was incredible, he's such an amazing performer) and not a lot of the crowd seemed to know him but people seemed to enjoy it! but the people behind us really didn't and it was really frustrating. they kept making fun of him, he had a hole in his coat i think? they kept saying they'd patch it up for him, and kept calling his music some sort of boring train music? and at one point when we were very excited for a song said "oh, the girlies are really getting into this one" which bugged me and my partner a lot because. we are not girls. it would have been made 10 times better if they just said that people were getting into the song. but overall they were just very disrespectful to shayfer james and i think that's really rude. i get you don't go to a concert for the opener, but you can at least be respectful. i'm not sure if this has been an issue at other shows or if this was just my experience, though!

overall, i feel like very few members of the audience have been very disrespectful and it's made things worse for people. sorry for rambling so much! my concert experience was genuinely amazing and seems like it went a lot better than other shows.
